work_item.role: W1 public-evidence discovery and neutral admission

discovery_pass.method: Direction-blind admission of the completed same-model-same-task headline run: eight framework adapters, ten fixed jobs and three trials per job, all routed to Gemini 2.5 Flash through Google's OpenAI-compatible endpoint with the same four deterministic tools and shared benchmark contract. W1 preserves deterministic NDCG@3 and Hit@1 aggregates, valid/total run denominators and auxiliary telemetry without reproducing the source ordering.
discovery_pass.headline_run_period: 2026-05-09 onward; exact start timestamp preserved per raw framework result file where published

source_known_dimensions: same Google generativelanguage OpenAI-compatible endpoint and single GEMINI_API_KEY contract
same hard MAX_STEPS=25 benchmark ceiling expressed through framework-specific controls
same ten fixed jobs and three trials per job per framework
same candidate dataset, prompts and four deterministic tool implementations
same deterministic NDCG@3/Hit@1 scorer and gold relevance construction
all eight framework raw headline JSON files are committed and contain per-run model label, raw final output, parsed output, validity and telemetry
explicit_unknown_or_nonidentical_dimensi: exact Google service-side Gemini 2.5 Flash checkpoint/revision
exact installed upstream framework/library versions for the historical run are not recorded in the raw result files; dependency ranges and benchmark adapter revision are public
Python and TypeScript framework runtimes and provider/message serialization differ by design
framework-specific retry/event-loop behavior and invalid-run failure modes differ
raw headline files preserve final model output and per-run metrics but not complete internal tool-call/message trajectories
service-side stochasticity remains despite three trials per job
aggregate correctness and telemetry are computed over valid runs, whose counts differ across framework arms

provenance_strength.w1_treatment: admitted from committed raw run JSON plus committed deterministic aggregate; framework ordering and source conclusions are not promoted

non_admission_dispositions.surface: source leaderboard ordering and framework selection recommendations
non_admission_dispositions.reason: W1 preserves eight factual rows and common-group provenance without ordering the frameworks or selecting a winner.

The source itself documents Gemini-on-Gemini self-preference concerns and uses the LLM judge only for prose-quality assessment. W1 treats deterministic NDCG@3/Hit@1 as the primary factual outcome and retains JustifQ only as publisher telemetry.
Those are separate one-trial compatibility canaries on different model families, not part of the completed Gemini 2.5 Flash headline comparison.

commands_required: python scripts/admission_check.py <each of eight pass-24 raw records>
